name: TimestampPicker
intent: A pill-shaped selector for choosing a captured timestamp. Clicking the pill opens a calendar where dates with captured data are marked with a dot (dates without data are disabled). Selecting a date reveals a scrollable list of the times captured on that day.

lineage.authoredBy: Group C of the missing-widgets template review (2026-08-26)
lineage.confidence: unset — intent taken verbatim from the module's own doc comment; contract not yet enumerated
notes: Was exported from @corensystem/coren-ui with no manifest at all, so it did not exist to the builder, to library-index.json, or to any agent selecting components.
Stub by design: the intent is accurate, the data contract is not yet authored.
